verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a full public GraphQL API with bearer-token auth, queries/mutations (transcripts, uploadAudio), and a quickstart guide, and runtime probes confirm the live GraphQL endpoint enforces auth exactly as documented. This is corroborated by hands-on probes, not just vendor claims. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/swagger spec discoverable and no independent third-party developer testimonial beyond internal docs.
